subject: infoschema: support cached table for infoschema v2 (#55139)
summary: Infoschema v2 now uses the same cached-table initialization path as v1 when (re)loading table metadata: `infoschemaV2.loadTableInfo` calls shared `tableFromMeta(allocs, factory, tblInfo)` which runs `CachedTable.Init()` using a factory-provided internal session SQL executor. Builder/virtual-table drivers are updated to pass the factory through and adapt to the new `tableFromMetaFunc` signature; a v2 regression test covers eviction+reload of cached tables.
